data.name: Name
data.mobile_action: Show "Mailbox emptied" action in the push notification

data_description.vibration_sensor: Binary sensor that triggers when mail is dropped in.
data_description.mobile_action: Adds a button (iOS and Android) to the notification that marks the mailbox as emptied.
data_description.repeat_message: Sent when the sensor triggers again while mail is still present (with the "emptied" action).
data_description.debounce_seconds: Further vibrations within this time are ignored.
data_description.mobile_targets: Services such as mobile_app_iphone. Multiple devices possible.

data_description.mobile_targets: Services such as mobile_app_iphone. Multiple devices possible.

data_description.from: If To is before From, the window spans midnight (e.g. 22:00 to 06:00). It belongs to the weekday it starts on.
data_description.players: Each player is used only once per ring, by the first matching profile.

pool_menu.title: Pool pump
pool_menu.description: Pump, time windows and dry-run detection of the pool pump.

window_edit.title: Time window
window_edit.description: The pump is switched on at the start and off at the end. If the end is earlier than the start, the window runs past midnight. The days refer to the day the window starts.

dry_run.title: Dry-run detection
dry_run.description: Detects a pump running dry: the pump is on and the power stays between the lower and upper limit for the set duration. Without a power sensor the feature is off. An alarm stays until acknowledged or the pump is restarted.

data.dry_auto_off: Switch the pump off on dry run and pause the schedule

data_description.dry_auto_off: The schedule is only re-enabled after acknowledging (button).
data_description.power_entity: Without a power sensor the detection is off.
data_description.mobile_targets: Services such as mobile_app_iphone. Multiple devices possible.
